name: Scott Mangold
occupation: Park County commissioner; the Powell Tribune reported that he is a former mayor of Powell and a co-owner, host, and announcer of KPOW radio in Powell
prior_offices: Park County commissioner (the Powell Tribune reported in March 2024 that he was seeking a second and, he said, final term). Former mayor of Powell.
background: Scott Mangold is a Park County commissioner. The official commissioners page lists him on the board. The Powell Tribune reported in March 2024 that he lives in Powell, is a former mayor of Powell, and is a co-owner, host, and announcer of the KPOW radio station in Powell, and that he was running for a second term after Commissioner Lee Livingston chose not to run again. He won election in the November 2024 general election.
